openai.official_standing: API data is not used for training by default. Chat Completions and embeddings have up to 30-day abuse-monitoring retention by default and are eligible for approved Zero Data Retention controls. Eligibility is not proof that this project has ZDR enabled.
openai.repository_verification: No durable project-level retention attestation or response receipt is present.

anthropic.official_standing: Anthropic states that API inputs and outputs are automatically deleted within 30 days by default, subject to stated exceptions, or under a separately agreed zero-retention arrangement.
anthropic.repository_verification: No durable workspace retention-mode attestation is present.

google_ai.official_standing: Google states that Paid Services prompts and responses are not used to improve its products, but abuse-monitoring logs and some features retain data. Guaranteed enterprise ZDR requires a different verified service posture. UK API clients may use only Paid Services under the current terms.
google_ai.repository_verification: The code uses Gemini Developer API keys but does not prove that the project is paid, which retention mode applies or that an enterprise ZDR route is in force.

xai.official_standing: xAI states that API inputs and outputs are not used for training without permission, are stored for 30 days by default and can use team-level ZDR. API responses expose x-zero-data-retention so a caller can verify the active mode.
xai.repository_verification: The current caller does not inspect or retain x-zero-data-retention.

elevenlabs.official_standing: ElevenLabs documents default request retention and an eligible Enterprise Zero Retention Mode for text to speech, enabled per API request with enable_logging=false. Non-ZRM generations can be deleted, but debugging and moderation logs may remain and backups can persist for up to 30 days.
elevenlabs.repository_verification: The current TTS request does not send enable_logging=false and stores no retention-mode receipt.

required_before_runtime: contract or console evidence for every account-level retention mode
request-level controls where the provider supports them
response-level verification where the provider exposes it
provider request identity and data-class receipt
a fail-closed route when the promised privacy mode cannot be proved
next_gate: Map delivery, billing and research-provider controls, then design one provider-receipt registry that can encode default, contractual and request-verified modes without overstating deletion.
